text:
Sam (People Ops): Heads up team  Ana's NICU situation extended and she might need an extra 3 weeks. also flagged: she's on an H-1B and has a visa check-in coming up. what do we need to coordinate?

Priya (HR Benefits): oh no 497. immediate items: confirm extended leave dates, updated medical note, and whether she wants employer-sponsored benefits to continue. for visa: need to confirm her work authorization status during leave with Legal. benefits continuation usually ok but dependent coverage and worksite rules vary for international status.

Liam (Eng Manager): coverage side: we should staff a short-term contractor for feature work; ContractingBot can spin a temp. i'll freeze noncritical roadmap items and patch critical tickets. can someone post a one-paragraph handoff?

Ana (Employee): thanks everyone. NICU stay now expected 2-3 weeks. she asked if premiums will still be taken and whether 401k contributions pause. also worried about visa check appointment date 613.

Priya (HR Benefits): premiums: default is benefits continue and employee premiums are deducted if on paid leave or if you elect COBRA-like continuation. 401k: employee salary deferrals stop if payroll earnings are zero; employer match rules depend on plan. i'll DM you the exact plan doc.

Sam (People Ops): Legal is cc'd here (looping in Priya); Legal will confirm visa implications. Ana, please upload the medical note and also the expected return date to the HR portal: https://hr.redwood-inference.com/leaves

ContractingBot: Action created: temp-contractor request for "infra-routing" (owner: Liam). ETA candidate shortlist in 48h.

Liam (Eng Manager): i'm scheduling a 30-min async handoff slot tomorrow. will include oncall swap details and PR list.

Payroll: Quick note 4b0 payroll needs the updated leave dates before cutoff to apply paid leave benefits correctly. if dates come after cutoff we'll process a retro adjustment and note potential 1-2 paycycle delay.

Priya (HR Benefits): checklist for Ana to close out: 1) upload updated medical note; 2) confirm extended return date; 3) choose benefits continuation option; 4) confirm any PTO conversion; 5) notify manager if you'll be unavailable for visa appointment date.

Ana (Employee): i've uploaded the note and tentatively set return as 3 weeks from now. prefers benefits to remain active. will check visa appointment and update by EOD.

Sam (People Ops): great. i'm opening a short-term accommodation case to track visa + benefits + payroll. i'll also mark a hiring freeze exception for the contractor role.

Payroll: Received docs. we'll queue the payroll updates; expect confirmation after next run.

Priya (HR Benefits): Ana, i'll send you a short summary email with plan impacts and 401k/SS options. also sending a benefits FAQ for international employees on leave.

TimeOffBot: Reminder 514 payroll cutoff in 4 business days for pay period ending 1784227200. Upload at https://hr.redwood-inference.com/leaves

Liam (Eng Manager): thanks everyone. Ana 64f rest up, we'll cover things. i'll post the handoff doc in #eng in the morning.

Sam (People Ops): keeping this thread as the single source for updates. if anything changes ping me directly and i'll update Payroll and Legal. :pray:
